description: E7.1 Domain Kernel artifacts are frozen. Any modification requires Architecture Change Request (ADR) + review + re-baseline.

ItemDomain.update: static update(existingItem: Item, updates: Partial<UpdateItemProps>): Result<Item>
ItemDomain.canTransitionTo: static canTransitionTo(item: Item, newStatus: ItemStatus): Result<void>

InventoryDomain.reserve: static reserve(inventory: Inventory, props: ReserveInventoryProps): Result<Inventory>
InventoryDomain.releaseReservation: static releaseReservation(inventory: Inventory, props: ReleaseReservationProps): Result<Inventory>
InventoryDomain.updateQuantity: static updateQuantity(inventory: Inventory, props: UpdateInventoryQuantityProps): Result<Inventory>
InventoryDomain.changeStatus: static changeStatus(inventory: Inventory, newStatus: InventoryStatus, reason?: string): Result<Inventory>

MovementDomain.canTransitionTo: static canTransitionTo(movement: Movement, newStatus: MovementStatus): Result<void>

LocationDomain.update: static update(existingLocation: Location, updates: Partial<UpdateLocationProps>): Result<Location>
LocationDomain.canTransitionTo: static canTransitionTo(location: Location, newStatus: LocationStatus): Result<void>

UOMDomain.update: static update(existingUOM: UnitOfMeasure, updates: Partial<UpdateUOMProps>): Result<UnitOfMeasure>
UOMDomain.convert: static convert(quantity: number, fromUOM: UnitOfMeasure, toUOM: UnitOfMeasure): Result<number>
UOMDomain.canTransitionTo: static canTransitionTo(uom: UnitOfMeasure, newStatus: UOMStatus): Result<void>

frozenInvariants: Item SKU must be unique per tenant
UOM code must be unique per tenant
UOM conversion factor must be positive
Location code must be unique per tenant
Serial number must be unique per item
Lot number required for serial number

regressionSuite.requirement: All 366 tests must pass on every commit touching Logistics OS

changeProcess.prohibition: Direct modification of frozen artifacts is PROHIBITED without explicit architecture review
procedure: 1. Identify suspected defect or required change
3. Include: rationale, impact analysis, alternative approaches
5. If approved: create ADR documenting decision
6. Make changes with explicit ACR reference

enforcement.ciRegressionGate: Always run E7.1 test suite on every commit
